verdict.rationale: The README gives separate install commands for each harness: a Claude Code marketplace plugin (gh-9, docs-10), Codex plugin marketplace commands (gh-10) and Copilot plugin commands (gh-11). It also offers a generic `npx skills add` installer that lets you pick your agents (docs-47, docs-48), and the site claims it works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot (docs-42, docs-49). A real runtime probe confirmed the `-a claude-code` install path works end-to-end (probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: a dedicated Cursor-specific install instruction (Cursor appears only in the 'works with any agent' claim), and hands-on verification on harnesses other than Claude Code.
